text: Based on the available evidence, there were **no thermal detections** from NASA FIRMS for the full period (2026-10-13 to 2026-11-12) within the asset boundary. However, there was a **temporal gap** in data coverage from VIIRS_SNPP between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-06, meaning no detections were possible during those days. For all other days, the sensors (MODIS, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and VIIRS_SNPP) confirmed zero detections. Still, small or short-lived fires could have occurred undetected.
